design.research_question: S12: can a deception model generalize to completely unseen participant pairs?
design.inner_cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(3) on pair_id within the 11 training dyads (S19); falls back to GroupKFold(3) if stratification is infeasible (not observed on this data).
design.feature_set: reliable_plus_marginal (1,770 columns), inherited unchanged from exp1 for comparability -- changing the feature set and the splitter at once would confound the exp1-vs-exp2 contrast this experiment exists to make.
design.relation_to_exp1: exp1 pooled = upper bound; exp2 LODO = the generalization claim (exp1's own results file states this verbatim).

half_size_reasons.sub01_sub02: genuine single-session dyad -- only ever ran one session.
half_size_reasons.sub19_sub22: 1 of 2 sessions unrecoverable at preprocessing (S9): the Player_sub22_Observer_sub19 session (pair_num==21 in the OneDCNN archive). The OTHER session survived and is fully represented here. Distinct reason from sub01_sub02 -- do not conflate.

dyad_reconciliation.note: The dispatch premise that sub19_sub22 has zero rows was checked against the parquet at execution time and found false; corrected here per plan Step 2.

comparison_to_exp1.interpretation: exp2 LODO AUROC is meaningfully below exp1's pooled AUROC. exp1 is an upper bound and sanity check, not the generalization claim (exp1's own results file states this verbatim); exp2 is where the generalization claim is made. This gap is evidence the pooled model was partly recognizing participants rather than deception -- the S19 leakage channel the LODO design exists to close.
